title: Campus Lost & Found
description: A full-stack web application that streamlines the recovery of lost belongings by allowing users to submit reports, manage item listings, search matches, and facilitate communication between finders and owners.

title: Chat Server Console App
description: A real-time messaging platform developed in C++ that allows multiple users to connect and communicate through a centralized server while showcasing socket programming and networking concepts.

title: Wilder Cards
description: An AI-powered mobile app that lets users photograph plants and animals, identifies the species, delivers detailed info, and turns nature-watching into a fun, gamified learning journey.

title: EduChat
description: A real-time chat app for classrooms with secure logins, class-specific rooms, and instant text or image sharing.

title: Balance Buddy
description: A personal finance tracker with real-time balance, simple +/- amount description input, editable and deletable transactions, and clear income/expense indicators.

title: Selamna Hiwet Ministries (Ongoing)
description: A bilingual ministry platform designed to share vision, highlight outreach programs, and connect supporters through donations, volunteering, and partnership opportunities.
